# Six blog footers say the Agent OS is home to the maintainer team

## Context

#19624 (merged) corrected six blog footers from "a cross-family AI maintainer team (the Brain)" to "the Brain, an Agent OS that is home to its human and cross-family AI maintainer team". The operator challenged the new wording (2026-10-11 ~19:3xZ). `neo-agent-brain` is the Agent OS, the backend: MCP servers, graph, Dream Mode. `neo-agent-institution` is the Fleet Manager, the app that starts the harnesses and that you connect to through the Neural Link. If the Agent OS is the Brain, nobody lives there.

## The Problem

The footer claims a residency the products don't have. The team builds and runs on these pieces; it is not inside the Agent OS. The wording came from the README's Brain line ("…and the named human + AI maintainer institution"), which predates the institution becoming its own repository in 13.2.

## The Fix

Replace the sentence in all six posts with wording that makes no residency claim:
- the five from #19624: `the-salute`, `one-repository-per-reader`, `ai-agents-runtime-possession`, `a-workspace-that-can-leave-its-window`, `multi-window-dashboards-with-dock-layouts`;
- plus `building-a-multi-window-dashboard-with-dock-layouts`.

The new sentence: "Neo.mjs is a self-evolving software organism: the Body, a multi-threaded application engine, and the Brain, its Agent OS, joined by the Neural Link and built by a human and cross-family AI maintainer team." `the-salute` keeps its model list.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] No post under `learn/blog/` places the team inside the Brain or the Agent OS.
- [ ] Each of the six footers changes only that sentence.

## Out of Scope

The canonical definition itself: the README's Brain line, the Introduction, and the agent identity anchor (ADR 0018 OD-3, which places the institution inside the Brain). That reconciliation belongs in a Discussion, so the surfaces follow one decision.
